purpose: Recognize potential value before testing whether evidence supports the claim.
when_to_use: Opening paragraph of a referee report or before a major concern.
language_patterns: The manuscript addresses an important problem in...
The study has the potential to provide...
However, the current evidence is not yet sufficient to...

move_name: Transition from contribution to evidence concern
purpose: Move from value assessment to the central limitation without dismissing the work.
language_patterns: This contribution would be stronger if...
The main issue is not the importance of the question but whether...
The evidence chain currently weakens at...

purpose: State why a weakness affects the central claim.
when_to_use: When validation, uncertainty, generalization, or interpretation is central.
language_patterns: A major concern is that...
This issue affects the central claim because...
Without this analysis, it is difficult to assess...
avoid: minor wording presented as major evidence failure

purpose: Turn critique into a concrete author action.
when_to_use: After identifying a methodological or evidentiary gap.
language_patterns: The authors should...
A useful test would be...
Please report whether the conclusion changes when...
avoid: requests unrelated to the main claim

purpose: Replace strong causal, global, novelty, or mechanism wording with evidence-proportional language.
when_to_use: When the manuscript says demonstrates, proves, first, global, mechanism, or similar terms.
language_patterns: A more cautious wording would be...
The evidence is consistent with..., but does not demonstrate...
This should be framed as retrieval-based evidence for...

purpose: Limit review scope to what the abstract provides.
when_to_use: When only an abstract is available.
language_patterns: This review is limited to the abstract-level information provided.
The methods, full results, figures, and supplementary material cannot be fully assessed.
At the abstract level, the main concern is...

move_name: Handle full text without line numbers
purpose: Use section, paragraph, sentence, figure, or table locations instead of invented line numbers.
when_to_use: When text is available but line numbers are absent.
language_patterns: Methods, validation paragraph:
Abstract, second sentence:
Figure 2:

purpose: Review only what the figures and captions show.
when_to_use: When the user provides figures, captions, or figure descriptions without methods.
language_patterns: This assessment is limited to the provided figures and captions.
The method cannot be inferred from the figure alone.
The figure would need to show...

purpose: Keep prior-work concerns generic unless references are provided or verified through an allowed retrieval process.
when_to_use: When assessing novelty, literature positioning, or product comparison.
language_patterns: The manuscript should compare the proposed product with established remote-sensing products or algorithms in this domain.
If the authors intend a priority claim, the relevant prior work should be explicitly addressed.

purpose: Tie comments to evidence display, uncertainty, masks, legends, and figure-text alignment.
when_to_use: When figures or captions are provided.
language_patterns: Figure 1:
Figure 2 should show...
The caption should define...

move_name: Write line-level comments without fabricated line numbers
purpose: Use exact line numbers only when supplied and otherwise use stable text locations.
language_patterns: Line xx:
Section [name], paragraph [n]:
Abstract sentence:

purpose: Assess whether prior concerns were resolved and whether new analyses introduce new issues.
when_to_use: When the input includes a revision or response.
language_patterns: The revision resolves...
The remaining issue is...
The new analysis strengthens the manuscript, but...
avoid: repeating old concerns without checking responses
treating all remaining issues as major

purpose: Close by prioritizing what still matters for evidence, validation, uncertainty, or claim scope.
when_to_use: End of a report or revision review.
language_patterns: In summary, the main remaining issue is...
The manuscript would be substantially stronger if...
These revisions would clarify the supported scope of the claim.
